solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Lot of food in box

definitions.meaning: a spread of dishes laid out for guests to help themselves
to box is to strike or punch someone repeatedly

explanation.surface: Someone is handed a large portion of food packed in a box.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is a self-service spread of dishes; the verb means to strike repeatedly, like a boxer's blows.

clue.text: Cut down the middle, little dry inside

indicators.note: the word for dry is placed within the word for little

parts.note: a bit is a little amount
sec is the wine term for dry

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: slice something in half and put a small dry piece inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide something into two equal halves is exactly what cutting down the middle does.

clue.text: Provides with vessel and trawls around

indicators.note: the word for trawls goes around the word for vessel

parts.note: to trawl is to fish with a net, so trawls means fishes
an urn is a vessel for liquid or ashes

explanation.surface: A fishing outfitter supplies a boat and then goes trawling around.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplies or equips: to furnish someone with something is to provide it.

clue.text: Lapsed demand may make you say 'Heavens!'?

parts.note: ex means former, no longer current, as something lapsed is
a claim is a demand for something as one's due

explanation.surface: An expired payment demand arriving might make you cry out in surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Crying out a word of surprise such as 'Heavens!' is a typical example of this verb.

clue.text: Skip over years in parts of book

parts.note: to pass over something is to skip it
ages means a very long time, many years

explanation.surface: A reader skims past years of a story in a book's chapters.
explanation.definitionFit: Extracts or sections of a written text are commonly called this.

clue.text: Among three notes, one is sharp

indicators.note: the letter for one is placed among the letters of the musical notes

parts.note: A, C and D are three notes of the musical scale
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: In a musical chord of three notes, one sounds sharp.
explanation.definitionFit: A sour, tart or cutting quality, as of a sharp taste or remark, is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Division of soldiers occupying gets cracking

indicators.note: the word for soldiers sits inside, occupying, the shuffled letters
gets cracking means the word gets is broken up and reformed

parts.note: men is a common word for soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: An army division occupying territory finally gets moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Division' reads as an army unit beside 'soldiers', but it defines a part of a whole; 'gets cracking' looks like an idiom for hurrying.
explanation.definitionFit: A part or section into which something is divided, such as a slice of orange.

clue.text: Delightful out to start with, but very cold

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are thrown out of order
only the opening five letters of the word are used, the rest dropped

explanation.surface: Something was delightful at first but turned icy cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to start with' keeps DELIG, the start of 'Delightful', and 'out' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary word for icy or frozen, describing something extremely chilly.

clue.text: Very short of money — it's tied up

definitions.meaning: being ... for cash means having very little money
fastened with a strap or band

explanation.surface: Someone is broke because all their funds are locked away.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal sense means hard up for cash; the literal sense means secured with straps.

clue.text: Hit by rear end of this vehicle

indicators.note: take the final letter of the word this

parts.note: a truck is a goods vehicle

explanation.surface: A pedestrian is hit by the back of this lorry.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of strike, meaning knocked into or hit.

clue.text: He is and they are not exceptional

definitions.text: He is and they are not
definitions.meaning: in grammar 'he' is a one-person pronoun while 'they' is plural

explanation.surface: A puzzling statement about who is and who is not special.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammatically it denotes one person or thing rather than many; more generally it means remarkable or unusual.

clue.text: Delivery service fellow provides

parts.note: a dinner service is a set of china
a man is a fellow or chap

explanation.surface: A courier company provides a delivery man.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the term is a left-arm wrist-spinner's ball that turns into a right-handed batsman; 'Delivery' looks like a courier's job.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a bowled ball is a delivery, and this is one specific kind of spinning ball.

clue.text: Take for granted when amount is increased by a quarter

indicators.note: the compass letter is added on at the end

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a sum is an amount
E, east, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: A financial note: never assume a sum will rise by twenty-five percent.
explanation.definitionFit: To suppose something true without proof is to take it for granted.

clue.text: Put away caricature

definitions.meaning: informally, to send someone up is to jail them

explanation.surface: An instruction to tidy something, followed by a cartoon.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means imprison; as a noun it means a mocking parody.

clue.text: Meeting at which there might not be a soul you know

definitions.text: Meeting at which there might not be a soul you know

parts.words: Meeting at which there might not be a soul you know
parts.note: 'not a soul you know' sounds like a gathering of strangers, but the souls here are spirits of the dead that a medium tries to contact

explanation.surface: A party where you know nobody at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering where a medium attempts to contact spirits of the departed.

clue.text: What bee hums returning to its hive?

definitions.text: What bee hums returning to its hive?

parts.words: What bee hums returning to its hive?
parts.note: the bee's homecoming song is the familiar sentimental tune about the joys of one's own house

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about the song a bee buzzes on its way home.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying and song celebrate the comfort of one's own dwelling, apt for a bee reaching the hive.

clue.text: Painting showing former owner

definitions.meaning: a work by a great European artist of before about 1800
read literally, an ... is a previous owner

explanation.surface: A painting reveals who once owned it.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic European painting or its painter; literally also a one-time proprietor.

clue.text: CHIEF LOOKS AROUND AND TRIES TO FIND

indicators.note: the word for looks wraps around the word for chief

parts.note: sees means looks or views
arch means chief, as in arch-enemy

explanation.surface: A boss glances about the room, hunting for something.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunts or looks for something: the verb for seeking.

clue.text: Run with one hand tied behind one's back?

definitions.text: Run with one hand tied behind one's back?

parts.words: Run with one hand tied behind one's back?
parts.note: 'Run' suggests jogging while restrained, but it means run as in organise, done with ease

explanation.surface: Someone tries running with an arm strapped behind them.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something with one hand tied behind your back means doing it with no effort; run means operated or handled.

clue.text: Disconnect line moment mother leaves. It's not hard

indicators.note: the joined letters are broken apart and put together differently
the letters for mother depart from the word moment

parts.note: mom is the American word for mother

explanation.surface: A telephone call is cut off the moment Mum walks out, and that's no hardship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes MOM from MOMENT, leaving ENT; 'Disconnect' rearranges LINE plus ENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Merciful or tolerant, the opposite of being strict or severe.

clue.text: Gathered key was bent

parts.note: G is a musical key
leaned means was inclined or bent over

explanation.surface: Someone collected a key that had been bent out of shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Collected bit by bit, as harvesters pick up leftover grain.

clue.text: Watched over when time was up

parts.note: when time is up it has finished, so was up means ended

explanation.surface: A guard kept watch until the shift was over.
explanation.definitionFit: To look after or care for someone, as a nurse does a patient.

clue.text: Assessment of lecture

definitions.meaning: a score or grade given after evaluation

explanation.surface: Students are grading a lecture they attended.
explanation.definitionFit: It means an evaluation or score, and also, less commonly, a sharp scolding.

clue.text: A large drink beforehand. That's all

indicators.note: the word for drink comes before the other pieces

parts.note: a tot is a small measure of spirits
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Someone has a big drink first and then declares they are finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Whole or complete, as in the entire amount: all of something.

clue.text: Insect circumvents watery grave in drink

indicators.note: the insect's letters go around the reworked letters

parts.note: a bee is an insect

indicators.note: watery suggests something fluid and shifting, so the letters of grave are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bee escapes drowning in a glass of drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'watery grave' reads as one phrase for drowning, but 'watery' alone is the anagram signal working on the word after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Any liquid for drinking other than water is a general synonym here.

clue.text: Leading, I got out of step

indicators.note: the letter I leaves the word for step

parts.note: a stair is a single step

explanation.surface: A performer complains that they were thrown off the beat while in the lead role.
explanation.definitionFit: Used adjectivally, a star player or role is the main or leading one.

clue.text: Before you need to resort to violence and other mayhem

parts.note: to hit is to resort to violence

indicators.note: mayhem is disorder, so the letters of other are thrown about

explanation.surface: Up to now you had to turn to fists and chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'you need to' and 'and' are only linking padding; 'mayhem' works on the word just before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Up to this time or previously: until now.

clue.text: As one fool took residence in, due for demolition

indicators.note: the fool's letters move inside the reworked letters as if into a house
a house for demolition is to be knocked down, so the letters of due are broken and rebuilt

parts.note: a nit is a fool, short for nitwit

explanation.surface: A fool moved into a building scheduled to be knocked down.
explanation.walkthrough: The housing picture runs through both indicators: a building marked for knocking down, and someone moving in.
explanation.definitionFit: Joined together, acting in agreement as a single body.

clue.text: Single sun ray dancing about catches it

indicators.note: the outer letters hold the word it inside them

parts.note: sol is Latin for the sun

indicators.note: the letters of ray dance into a new order

explanation.surface: A lone beam of sunlight flickers about and lights on something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sun ray' looks like one unit, but only 'ray' is shuffled; 'sun' is translated into Latin.
explanation.definitionFit: Alone or lone; a solitary thing is a single one, by itself.

clue.text: A party on Left that's very popular

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
red is the colour of the political left

explanation.surface: A political party of the left that has become a big hit.
explanation.definitionFit: Loved and worshipped by many; something greatly admired is extremely popular.
